message.text:
**Searching for SSE handlers**

I need to figure out how the answer mechanism for Server-Sent Events (SSE) is set up. It seems like hub sse_hub.go is where the handlers broadcast data. I should identify the memo handlers for broadcasting. To dig deeper, I can search for `SSEHub.Broadcast` in the API version 1 using Perl. This should help clarify how everything connects!

args.command:
perl -e '
sub walk {my($d)=@_;opendir my $h,$d or return;while(my$n=readdir$h){next if$n eq"."||$n eq".."||$n eq"node_modules";my$p="$d/$n";if(-d$p){walk$p}elsif(-f$p){open my$f,"<",$p or next;while(<$f>){print "$p:$.:$_" if /SSEHub\.Broadcast|EventMemo/}close$f}}closedir$h}walk("server/router/api/v1")'
